requirements.quote: Write these counts to a new file called `/home/user/k8s-configs/kind_frequency.txt`.
Count the occurrences of each distinct `kind` across all the files.

check.cmd: grep -hE '^kind:' /home/user/k8s-configs/*.yaml | sed -E 's/^kind:[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]+$//; s/^["'\'']//; s/["'\'']$//' | LC_ALL=C sort | uniq -c | awk '{print $2" "$1}' | LC_ALL=C sort -k2,2nr -k1,1 | cmp -s - /home/user/k8s-configs/kind_frequency.txt

requirements.quote: Each line consists of two fields separated by a single space: `<KIND-NAME> <COUNT>`
Lines must be ordered by descending COUNT value. If two kinds share the same count, order those two lines alphabetically by KIND-NAME.
a single trailing newline character at the very end of the file
For each manifest, find the value for the `kind:` key (there is exactly one per file).
Finally, remove the `/srv/quartz` directory tree. We need the space.
